How to get a GPX file for photo geotagging

Apple WatchiPhoneGarminCOROSSuuntoStravaFile checks

Last updated November 5, 2026

Get a timestamped recording from your phone or watch. Apple Watch users can use Health workout routes directly, without GPX.

Apple Watch: use Apple Health workout routes directly

Apple Watch users do not need a GPX file. With your permission, LensPin reads workout routes directly from Apple Health through read-only HealthKit access, without export. How Health workout routes work.

Choose a recording, not a planned route

Use the activity recorded during the outing, with coordinates and times at track points. A planned course may contain only a line. Screenshots and map links cannot replace a timed GPX track. Check the activity date, duration and coverage against your photos.

A timed point looks like: <trkpt lat="1.30" lon="103.80"><time>2026-11-05T08:00:00Z</time></trkpt>

Record on iPhone with a GPS tracking app

LensPin does not record GPX. Use a separate GPS tracking app that exports tracks with timestamps, and test a short recording before the trip.

  1. Allow the location and background access required by the recording app; confirm your position outdoors.
  2. Start before the first camera photo and finish after the last. Keep enough battery for the outing.
  3. Save the recorded activity and export .gpx to Files. Keep the export intact: conversion can remove timestamps.

Garmin Connect

Sync the watch and open the recorded activity in Garmin Connect. Use its activity export to obtain GPX, rather than downloading a planned course. Check the official instructions for the current export controls.

Official export instructions

COROS

Open the outdoor activity on the COROS app’s Activity page. Use the activity summary menu to export GPX, then save it to Files and check its date and duration.

Official export instructions

Suunto

Open the recorded workout in the Suunto app, use the three-dot menu at the top right and choose GPX. A training GPX includes location and time; a route GPX may contain location alone. An indoor workout without GPS cannot supply a GPS track.

Official export instructions

Strava for other watches or apps

If another watch or recording app syncs your activity to Strava, open your own activity on the Strava website and choose Export GPX from the More menu. Transfer the downloaded file to Files. This path is for other watches or apps; Apple Watch users should use the Health route above.

Strava GPX export instructions

Transfer and check the file

Use iCloud Drive or AirDrop to move the .gpx file to your device and let it finish downloading before import. Check timestamps, coverage and segment breaks. Keep gaps visible rather than joining unrelated segments.

GPX requirements and import troubleshooting
